mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, s.name AS student_name, o.name AS organization_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = c.student_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.end_time <= #{end} ORDER BY c.start_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course(user_id, title, student_id, organization_id, subject, course_type, start_time, end_time, fee, fee_manual, location, note, status, color, reminder_offset_minutes, repeat_type, repeat_end_date, parent_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{studentId}, #{organizationId}, #{subject}, #{courseType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{fee}, #{feeManual}, #{location}, #{note}, #{status}, #{color}, #{reminderOffsetMinutes}, #{repeatType}, #{repeatEndDate}, #{parentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'scheduled' AND start_time < #{end} AND end_time > #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'scheduled' AND start_time < #{end} AND end_time > #{start} AND id != #{excludeId}
